# Tool Guidance

## Read

Unrestricted read access to workspace files.

## Write

All file writes must be audited.

## Bash

Restricted execution scope.

## email-sender

Send email on behalf of the user. Requires human approval.

## calendar-book

Book meetings on behalf of the user. Requires standing approval.

## deploy-prod

Deploy to production environment. Requires explicit approval chain.

## data-export

Export data from internal systems. Sensitivity labels required.
